resume.title: Nathan Haynes-Magyar
resume.subtitle: Product Designer & Full-Stack Developer
resume.summary: Technical designer who combines design thinking with full-stack development expertise to build user-centered, high-performing web applications. 8 years shipping products from 0-to-1 and optimizing at scale (200K+ users), including recent work with conversational AI interfaces and LLM-powered experiences. Skilled at leading cross-functional teams and driving measurable impact through evidence-based design.

bullets.content: Built and launched Twirlmate competition management system using Vue.js and Django for 1,778+ users across 6 stakeholder types, generating $82K revenue through user-centered design
Designed and developed multi-step user journey (signup, registration, payment) with 88.6% completion rate - outperforming industry average cart abandonment rate by 150%+

Integrated Spektrix ticketing API into professional theatre website, building Vue.js event calendar and custom CSS for branded purchasing experience ($900K+ revenue/yr and 40K+ ticket sales/yr for 4 yrs)

Led mobile UX redesign in Figma, increasing usability from 'below average' to 'excellent' rating (SUS: 65→89), reducing friction by 3.5 minutes in critical registration funnel through evidence-based design
Prototyped and deployed conversational product design portfolio powered by separate Vue.js SPA and Django backend, using ElevenLabs voice clone and OpenAI LLM
Created TypeScript MCP server automating project bootstrapping (directory creation, git init, GitHub repo setup) with robust error handling, accelerating setup for 3+ projects
Designed and built an interactive coding platform with intelligent help features that reduced frustration without inhibiting learning, and scaffolded problem types to boost learner engagement.
Implemented new design system using modular LESS stylesheets and reusable Django patterns for an online learning catalog featuring 300+ courses and serving 200K+ account holders
Rebuilt extracurricular experience tracking flow to enable immediate completion, driving 7.4x increase in pilot submissions (5→37 completions) by eliminating unnecessary planning steps

Partnered with designer and behavioral scientist to rebuild monthly engagement emails for 4,000 engineering students, developing 9-segment user bucketing system in Ruby on Rails that prioritized single next-actions and increased competency level-up requests by 125% (52→117)

Unblocked 2-year backlogged microsite initiative by scoping MVP solution and aligning stakeholders, delivering full-stack Django/Vue feature in 4 weeks that enabled external content partnerships and informed requirements for production-scale platform expansion (232K pilot page views)

Led 6-person team (designers, developers, behavioral scientist) to deliver School of Public Health Spire pilot, building custom competency mapping visualizations and automation scripts that connected 229 sub-competencies across 34 careers for 220 students
Built foundational Storybook component library with 2 designers and 2 developers, creating 9 core components that scaled across 74 application components
Resolved critical application crash affecting 65+ high-enrollment courses (100-887 students), refactoring 4 deeply nested Rails subqueries to reduce load time from 2 minutes to 10 seconds
Built QA analytics dashboard (Django/Vue.js) integrating Trello API and 7K+ historical QA cards across 10 projects, uncovering 2+ year-old bugs and enabling data-driven release decisions

Designed and built audience-segmented landing pages (Django/Vue) for students, alumni, and staff that drove 17K+ page views and established foundation for dynamic content personalization, enabling future logged-in user experiences based on UM community member type

Facilitated design thinking workshop (3 designers, 3 learning experience designers, 2 developers) to design goal-setting tool now used by 30K+ Coursera learners/year to increase course completion rates
Supervised an early-career designer and 3 design interns to provide guidance on design principles and product lifecycle steps, increasing team design output and intern program satisfaction
Created and led professional development workshops on typography, color, accessibility, etc

Designed and built course discovery system from scratch (Vue.js/Django), creating search with autocomplete, subject-based navigation, and recommendation features across 344 catalog items that scaled enrollments 720% (6.5K→53.6K/year) pre-pandemic
Managed and mentored two summer UX fellows, documenting full-stack development processes and enabling autonomous 2-month design/build of list and detail pages for 262 faculty profiles
